beats.t: Yeoni climbed over the window frame and onto the roof. The tiles were slippery. The roof was far too round for a pig's hooves to grip.
What are you two doing here? At night. In secret. In the rain.
Yeoni. Go inside. It's dangerous here.
You coming to a dangerous place alone is even more dangerous!
The tiger looked from one to the other. Then it let out a tiny breath, somewhere between a sneer and a sigh.
That's enough for today. Nothing to put in the ledger.
Wait. What did you just say to Yeongnyangi?
If you're curious, ask the cat. Why his eyes sometimes turn gold.
The tiger jumped from the roof's edge. There was no sound of falling. Only the rain grew louder once, then faded.
Then I'll ask. Why do your eyes turn gold?
Reflected moonlight.
That's half a sun, and there's no moon. Nothing to reflect.
Yeoni. Let's just go inside tonight. I'll tell you tomorrow.
With you, it's always tomorrow. Always later, always when it's over.
Yeoni opened a hoof. The chart appeared. Its last blank was already glowing faintly.
Then I'll check for myself.
Yeoni stepped closer. The blank brightened. Yeongnyangi stepped back.
Another step. And another. Yeongnyangi's hind paws reached the roof's edge. There was nowhere left to retreat.
Yeoni, stop.
No.
The instant Yeoni's hoof touched the fluffy fur on Yeongnyangi's chest, white light burst from the blank. A clear ringing, like metal being struck, echoed through the sky.
The light stood straight as a blade, then gathered into one character. Cold, hard, and straight.
[ Year 壬午 · Month 丙午 · Day 乙亥 · Hour 庚辰 ]  8/8
It's full! All eight slots! Yeongnyangi, look!
[ Hour Stem 庚 · Borrowed slot · Owner unverified ]
Borrowed slot? Owner unverified? What does that mean?
The character 庚 shone, then flickered. It brightened when Yeongnyangi breathed in and dimmed when he breathed out. As though breathing with him.
Yeongnyangi. Is this you?
No.
It's breathing with you!
Coincidence.
As he said it, Yeongnyangi's fur briefly lost its luster. Its white tips faded to ash, then returned.
Your fur just now. The color drained out.
It's nighttime.
Do you know how many excuses you've made today? Moonlight, fur, night. What's next?
Weather.
Then the roof's small window burst open. Moka popped out holding an ember. Yundal climbed up behind him, yawning.
What?! Why's a bell ringing on the roof?! I thought there was a fire!
Ah, my lady. That slot. Finally filled, I see.
Yundal. This slot is breathing with Yeongnyangi.
Yundal looked between the chart and Yeongnyangi. Then he covered his mouth with his gloved hand, holding back a smile.
I see. So that's why you didn't know your birthday.
What does that mean? What does a birthday have to do with this slot?
I'll tell you tomorrow. If I tell you now, you might roll off the roof.
Con artist, you said that yesterday, too. Keep saying tomorrow, tomorrow, and you'll turn into a cat.
Yundal. Don't say anything this time.
The next morning, the four sat around a reading-room desk. It felt like a courtroom.
To be precise, three people and one animal. The baby dragon left Yeoni's wrist and coiled at the center of the desk like a judge.
Let's do this over breakfast. I grilled skewers. Trials need snacks.
Moka set down the plate. Yeoni and Yeongnyangi reached for the same skewer at the same time. Hoof and paw froze above it.
You have it.
No. You eat it.
No, I said you have it.
Why all the generosity over one skewer?! There are twelve! Twelve!
That skewer tells us everything about what happened on the roof last night.
Nothing happened! One slot lit up, that's all!
As Yeoni said it, their nose grew a shade deeper than pink. Yeongnyangi turned toward the window without even taking a skewer.
All right, Yundal. Finish what you were saying yesterday. You said Influence has another meaning in a woman's chart.
You really want to hear it now? Have you checked how hard the desk is?
Hurry up.
For an Eul Wood Day Master, Gyeong Metal is Direct Officer. The energy that helps you stand upright. And in a woman's chart, Direct Officer is...
Direct Officer is. Stop dragging it out. The meat's burning.
The husband star.
Yeoni's forehead hit the desk with a thud. A book Yundal had placed there in advance caught it.
That's why I told you to check how hard it was.
H-h-husband?
Ack. Cough. Wait. A skewer went down the wrong way.
A misunderstanding.
What else could it be?! Your breath is attached to the slot!
I'm Customer Support. Not a husband.
Who said I'd marry you?! I don't want to, either!
Neither do I.
Why don't you want to?!
Wow. Both saying they don't want to at once. Aren't they basically married already?
Mr. Otter's more accurate than I am, and I read compatibility for a living.
Yundal. Husband star doesn't mean an actual husband, right? Just the name of a star?
It's a star's name. A place in your chart that protects you, guides you, and makes you want to take responsibility.
It doesn't necessarily mean someone you'll marry. Just that there's someone who sits in that place.
(Someone who sits in that place. The cat who's stayed beside me since I first opened my eyes.)
Yeoni raised their head to look at Yeongnyangi. He stared only out the window. The tips of his ears were a little red.
(So cats' ears turn red, too.)
But enough joking. My lady, could you bring up that slot again?
Yeoni opened their hoof. 庚 still flickered. The farther Yeongnyangi moved toward the window, the fainter it grew.
A borrowed slot means this character wasn't originally yours. Mr. Cat is lending you his own.
Lending it? Then what happens to Yeongnyangi?
He becomes that much emptier. By the amount he lends.
So when the cat goes away, the slot goes dark. When he gets close, the cat empties out. What kind of messed-up contract is this?
The contract is a bit of a mess. None of your concern.
How could I not be concerned?! You're saying you're lending yourself to me.
I didn't lend it. You came closer, and it lit up.
Then let's check. My lady, could you bring out one vine?
Not understanding, Yeoni held out a hoof. A slender vine grew onto the desk, bending limply over its edge.
Now, Mr. Cat, please stand beside our lady.
No.
Say no, and I'll push you. With my tail.
With Moka shoving his back, Yeongnyangi reluctantly stood beside Yeoni. 庚 on the chart shone brightly.
At once, the drooping vine stood upright. Straight as a pillar, it stretched toward the ceiling. Its leaves were firm and gleaming.
What? I've never seen my vine this straight.
Eul Wood bends alone. With Gyeong Metal beside it, it stands straight. That's Direct Officer. The energy that helps you stand.
Yeoni looked from the vine to their side. Yeongnyangi was clenching his teeth. His left paw hovered just above the floor.
Yeongnyangi. Does it hurt?
No.
When Yeoni stepped away, the vine sagged again. Tension left Yeongnyangi's shoulders. He had been holding his breath.
Then I just need to stay away?
Yeongnyangi did not answer. His silence was the answer.
Then the circular skylight darkened. Though it was morning, the entire reading room rapidly sank into shadow as if the sun were setting.
What now? More rain?
No. Worse than rain.
Yundal clutched his gloved right hand to his chest. Inside the glove, something sounded like escaping air. The Void was inhaling on its own.
This hand has never been so hungry. I think I know what that thing up there wants to eat.
What does it want? Don't talk around it. My tail's standing on end because I'm scared.
The sky cracked beyond the glass. Starting at the half-eaten sun, a black fissure stretched across it.
Crack. The sound came not from the sky but from Yeoni's chart. A fine fracture marked a corner of 庚.
My slot cracked. Yeongnyangi, are you okay?
I'm fine.
Liar. Cat, your teeth are chattering. I can hear them from here.
Mr. Cat. Hiding it is hurting our lady more now.
As those words were spoken, Yeongnyangi hid his left paw behind his back. Yeoni saw the movement. This time, they did not pretend otherwise.
That paw. Show me.
Yeoni.
I said show me.
Yeongnyangi looked at Yeoni for a long time, then slowly started to hold out his paw. But before it fully emerged, the glass shook violently.
Found you.
The voice sounded from everywhere at once. Between the shelves, beyond the glass, inside the crack in Yeoni's chart.
The hidden fifth light. There you were, beside that child.
The fissure in the sky widened another handspan. Beyond it, something slowly opened its eyes.
